blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — Ate Gay got a front-row seat to his own funeral. Ate Gay, whose real name is Gil Aducal Morales, made the hearts of netizens drop after posting photos of what looked like a funeral. Later, it was revealed that the comedian held a living funeral on Thursday, October 15, at Forest Lake Memorial Parks in Biñan, Laguna. Relatives and close friends gathered to celebrate the comedian, sharing messages of love and gratitude, including comedians Boobsie Wonderland and content creator Arman Salon. “Celebration of Life […] Undasko 2026,” he captioned the photos.
